# TrueAim.ai

> Neuro-symbolic AI for auditable insurance claims decisions. Swiss precision meets compliant automation.

TrueAim.ai builds AI-powered decisioning software for insurance claims. Our hybrid neuro-symbolic approach combines the adaptability of agentic AI with the precision of deterministic logic, delivering compliant, explainable decisions at scale.

## Company

- Name: TrueAim AG
- Location: Zurich, Switzerland
- Industry: InsurTech / AI
- Website: https://trueaim.ai
- Contact: https://trueaim.ai/contact

## Products

- [MIRA](https://trueaim.ai/products/mira): Neuro-symbolic decisioning engine. Transforms policy terms and conditions into automated, fully-deterministic claim decisions. Every outcome traceable to the legal text.
- [ContextBuilder](https://trueaim.ai/products/contextbuilder): Claims document pipeline. Turns messy claim documents into structured, trusted data with AI-powered ingestion and human review when needed.
- [ClaimEval](https://trueaim.ai/products/claimeval): Claims quality assurance. Scales QA beyond sampling with consistent inspections across entire claims portfolios.

## Key Differentiators

- Neuro-symbolic architecture: Combines neural AI with deterministic logic
- 100% auditable decisions linked to policy clauses and source documents
- EU AI Act alignment by design
- Swiss-based with enterprise-grade security
